summarization.headline: Two-year mutual NDA between Brightline Analytics and Harbor & Finch to evaluate a data-analytics partnership.
key_points: Confidential information may be used only to evaluate the partnership.
Confidentiality survives three years after termination.

key_obligations: Keep the other party's Confidential Information strictly confidential
Use it solely for the Purpose
Limit access to employees with a need to know
summarization.termination_terms: Expires after two years; confidentiality obligations survive for three years after termination.
